name: Picter
description_en:
Picter Workspace organizes visual assets into projects and collections for feedback, review, approval and delivery. Its image markup and video annotations support conversations tied to the content, while share links let external collaborators participate without the same membership as an internal teammate.

Picter also operates photography open calls and brand services. This collaboration profile specifically covers Workspace, following a proposed campaign review from incoming files to comments and final delivery. Contest submission fees, jury processes and advertised audience reach are separate products and are not included as Workspace capabilities.
description_zh:
Picter Workspace 把视觉素材组织为项目和集合，用于反馈、审阅、批准及交付。图像标注和视频批注让讨论关联内容，共享链接则让外部协作者以不同于内部成员的方式参与。

Picter 还经营摄影公开征稿及品牌服务。本协作稿专门研究 Workspace，沿假设的活动素材审阅，从文件接收到评论及最终交付。比赛报名费、评审流程及宣传受众规模属于其他产品，不计为 Workspace 功能。

sections.title_en: Use Workspace for the creative review, not the contest workflow
sections.title_zh: 用 Workspace 处理创意审阅
sections.en:
A proposed campaign project can contain draft images, a short film and collections for different deliverables. Workspace’s role is to organize that material and its review, not to edit the underlying media files like a production authoring tool. The current product page describes collection organization, markup, video annotations, approval and tailored sharing.

Keep this separate from Picter’s open-call, media-placement and brand-engagement services. A customer logo or campaign outcome on the parent homepage does not establish the same functionality, staffing or commercial terms in a Workspace subscription. No actual content or project was uploaded.
sections.zh:
假设活动项目含图像草稿、短片及按交付物划分的集合。Workspace 用于组织素材和审阅，不是直接制作底层媒体文件的创作工具。当前产品页描述集合整理、标注、视频批注、批准及定制共享。

这些应与 Picter 的公开征稿、广告位置和品牌活动服务区分。母站客户标识或活动成果，不证明 Workspace 订阅包含相同功能、人员服务及商业条件。本研究未上传素材或项目。

sections.title_en: Choose a link for intake, feedback or presentation
sections.title_zh: 按接收、反馈或展示选择链接
sections.en:
The official sharing walkthrough describes three different jobs. An Inbox link accepts external uploads without a new account. A Review link lets recipients comment and mark files approved/rejected. A Presentation link presents an ordered gallery, including animated GIFs. The current Workspace page continues to advertise tailored links for these collaboration tasks.

For the campaign example, request draft assets through intake, share selected material for review and then present the agreed sequence. Account-free participation is not verified identity or confidentiality. Before using live client content, inspect the actual link’s visibility, download control, expiration and revocation behavior; current help details could not be read safely and these controls remain unverified. The operational walkthrough dates from 2020 and was not executed.
sections.zh:
官方共享指南描述三项不同任务：Inbox 链接接受外部上传，无须新账户；Review 链接让接收者评论及标记批准／拒绝；Presentation 链接展示有序图库，含动画 GIF。当前 Workspace 页面仍宣传用于这些协作任务的定制链接。

在活动示例中，可先接收草稿，再共享选定素材审阅，最后展示商定顺序。免账户参与不等于已验证身份或保密。使用真实客户内容前应检查链接可见性、下载控制、到期及撤销，当前帮助细节无法安全读取，这些控制仍未核实。操作指南来自2020年，本研究未执行。

sections.title_en: Turn a precise comment into assigned work
sections.title_zh: 把精确评论转为已分配工作
sections.en:
The video walkthrough describes clicking a frame to pause, navigating individual frames with arrow keys and placing a comment on a location in the frame. That is useful for a proposed request to adjust a lower-third title without describing the moment in a separate email. The guide’s 2021 player update and current Workspace page support the general annotation capability; actual codec, duration, frame-rate and preview limits still need validation.

The comment article adds assignees, inline reply threads, resolution and a Tasks View across projects. Resolving the comment records progress on that item; it does not itself prove the edited file was uploaded, approved by every stakeholder or delivered. Keep the accepted final asset and responsible decision-maker explicit. Multi-approver thresholds, new-file replacement history and approval carry-over were not established.
sections.zh:
视频指南描述点击画面暂停，用方向键逐帧导航，并在帧内位置发表评论。假设需调整片中下方标题，可直接指出位置，而不必另写邮件描述时刻。指南的2021播放器更新及当前 Workspace 页面支持一般批注能力，实际编码、时长、帧率及预览限制仍需验证。

评论文章补充了分配负责人、内联回复串、解决状态和跨项目 Tasks View。解决评论记录该项进度，本身不证明已上传修改文件、所有人已批准或完成交付。应明确采纳的最终素材及决策负责人。多审阅者通过门槛、新文件替换历史及批准状态延续未确立。

sections.title_en: Membership, guest access and storage drive the bill
sections.title_zh: 成员、访客访问及存储决定账单
sections.en:
The current Workspace page lists Standard at €10/member/month and Pro at €20, both with 100GB/member. Pro adds workspace roles and invited project guests, shown as five guests per member; Standard lists owners only and no invited guests. Do not confuse a public reviewer with an invited guest or assume a role named viewer is an unbilled internal seat. Extra storage is €25/TB/month.

For an editorial example, three Standard members imply €30/month before applicable VAT; three Pro members plus one additional terabyte imply €85/month. This excludes any unverified discounts or other charges. The site advertises a seven-day trial, not a confirmed permanent-free plan. Actual checkout, storage pooling, guest counting/reuse, seat changes and annual pricing were not tested.
sections.zh:
当前 Workspace 页面列 Standard 每成员每月 €10，Pro €20，两者每成员100GB。Pro 增加工作区角色及受邀项目访客，显示每成员五名访客；Standard 列为仅所有者、不含受邀访客。不能把公开审阅者与受邀访客混同，也不能假定名为 viewer 的内部角色免费。额外存储每 TB 每月 €25。

编辑算例：三名 Standard 成员每月 €30，未加适用增值税；三名 Pro 加额外1TB 为 €85，未计未核实折扣及其他费用。网站宣传七天试用，不是已确认持续免费套餐。本研究未测试结账、存储池、访客计数／复用、席位变动或年价。

sections.title_en: Cancellation and a usable exit copy are separate tasks
sections.title_zh: 取消及可用退出副本是不同任务
sections.en:
The August 2025 terms provide a limited service-use license and distinguish monthly from annual subscriptions. Annual cancellation requires at least three months’ notice before expiry; renewals repeat the previous term unless terminated, and written notice is required. Ordinary termination does not promise reimbursement of prepaid fees. Confirm the applicable offer, especially where a custom quote or service package differs.

The terms also place regular backup/copy responsibility on the customer absent another written agreement. Before the review becomes operational, define an exit copy containing originals, selected finals, feedback, approvals and useful metadata. A delivery link alone does not establish a complete restorable workspace. Export formats, deletion recovery, retention after cancellation and full restore were not verified. The service is proprietary; no open-source or self-hosting grant was established.
sections.zh:
2025年八月条款提供有限服务使用许可，区分月度及年度订阅。年订阅须至少在到期前三个月通知取消，未终止则按前期长度续订，并要求书面通知。普通终止不承诺退还预付费。应确认适用方案，尤其定制报价或服务包存在差异时。

条款还要求客户定期备份／复制，除非另有书面约定。审阅流程投入运行前，应定义包含原稿、选定终稿、反馈、批准及有用元数据的退出副本。交付链接本身不确立可完整恢复的工作区。导出格式、删除恢复、取消后保留及完整恢复未核实。服务为专有，未确立开源或自托管授权。

sections.title_en: Validate the review boundary with non-sensitive material
sections.title_zh: 用非敏感素材验证审阅边界
sections.en:
The privacy notice describes account data handling as well as website hosting, analytics and contact processing. Website/CDN information is not a complete map of Workspace content processing. The product’s Ireland/AWS and GDPR claims were not treated as an independent audit or proof that every processing operation stays in one country. Obtain the relevant agreement for the intended content.

Workspace is a candidate for visual feedback and approval when the team can test recipient access and preserve a usable asset copy. Exact preview/file limits, link security, notification failure, AI processing, offline use, APIs and recovery remain unknown. The dedicated help host returned a certificate-name error in the browser; it was not bypassed, and search snippets were not counted as help-page reads. No account, review, payment or subscription was changed.
sections.zh:
隐私通知描述账户数据处理，也描述网站托管、分析及联系处理；网站／CDN 信息不是 Workspace 内容处理的完整映射。产品的爱尔兰／AWS 和 GDPR 主张未作为独立审计或全部处理留在一国的证明。应为目标内容取得适用协议。

当团队能够测试接收者访问并保留可用素材副本时，Workspace 可用于视觉反馈及批准。精确预览／文件限制、链接安全、通知失败、AI 处理、离线、API 及恢复仍未知。专属帮助主机在浏览器返回证书名称错误，未绕过，也未把搜索摘要算作帮助原页实读。本研究未改变账户、审阅、付款或订阅。
